title: tosk course.yaml
description: Units, skills (with selection queries) and the course's grammar dimensions. Compiled into meta/units/skills/skill_items/skill_facets.

min_app_version.description: oldest app that can use the pack (meta.min_app_version); default: 0.4.0 for packs with inflection facets

required_translations.description: the translations every taught item, sentence and story needs (default: all of translations); the others are optional and the app falls back to English where one is missing

tts.description: false: no text-to-speech voice exists for the target language, so apps never try one (no listening exercises, no voice hints); default true (meta.tts)

note_langs.description: languages every grammar skill needs a note in (default [en, nl])

attribution.description: meta.attribution text; default: generated from the sources used

license.description: licence of the pack content: an SPDX identifier ('CC-BY-SA-4.0') or 'LicenseRef-...' (meta.license; docs/pack-format.md, Credits)

data_sources.description: the sources the content comes from (meta.data_sources)

tense_persons.description: tenses whose tables have only some persons (an imperative without io): tense -> those persons; a table of the tense is complete with them

tense_person_labels.description: person labels that differ in one tense (imperative lui/lei = formal Lei): tense -> person -> i18n

tense_groups.description: tense -> group (a mood): the transform exercise changes the tense only between tenses of one group; unlisted tenses form one default group

base_features.description: grammar features allowed from the start (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, Grammar gating)

feature_detectors.description: construct features and how the pipeline detects them in sentences (pipeline/pipeline/features.py)

pronouns.description: reflexive: pronoun -> the person(s) it is reflexive for

clitics.description: reflexive: other clitics that may stand in the cluster before the verb

enclitic_any.description: reflexive: attached pronouns that are reflexive without a finite verb of their person

form.description: nonfinite: the verb form key (gerund, participle, infinitive)

pattern.description: nonfinite: regex for that form with attached clitics; pattern: regex searched in the lower-cased sentence text

annotate.description: pattern: match the text with every word followed by its aligned form in braces ('non{} parlare{infinitive._}')

unbound.description: reflexive: only pronouns that are no part of the verb's own (pronominal) form, e.g. impersonal 'si dice'

time_adverbs.description: time adverbs (one or more words) -> the tenses they fit; the app never rewrites a sentence with one into another tense

inflection_tables.description: non-verb inflection tables (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, Inflection tables; pipeline/pipeline/inflect.py builds them per language)

base.description: the cell equal to the lemma (given, never asked)

agreement.description: cells chosen by agreement: other cells are wrong in an aligned sentence

topics.description: built-in topic trees (pack format 1.2): themed side trees, each drawn as its own map and attached to the main tree at its anchor skill (docs/extensions.md)

short_title.description: a short name for the carving on the main tree's branch where the title does not fit (default: the title's first word)

anchor.description: the main-tree skill the topic's branch grows from, where the topic starts: the last main-tree skill its first skill requires (default: the deepest of those); later skills may require later main-tree skills

introduces.description: grammar features this skill teaches (a verbs skill also introduces tense:{T})

note.description: path of the English grammar note relative to the course folder; the Dutch one is the same path with .nl.md

recognition.description: recognition only: the learner recognises the items or forms and is never asked to produce them (items: #rec only; verbs: #form with recognition exercises only)

equivalent_tense.description: recognition verbs skill: the tense whose form of the same verb and person means the same (passato remoto -> passato prossimo), offered in 'which form means the same?'

facet.description: train this facet of the selected items instead of #rec/#prod ('infl': only the #infl:{table} facets of `inflections`)

inflections.description: train #infl:{table} of the items that inflect (in addition to #rec/#prod unless facet: infl)
